detail.longDescription: They put an AI chatbot where "Home" was before at work Slack, which is now one slot lower. Cannot be disabled or moved. I keep hitting it by accident, really fucking up my muscle memory. Decided to get back at it and waste some of its resources by having it solve some prime numbers or knapsack problems but it was pretty fast at those. So I gave it a 700 page PDF of "The History of the Modern Middle East" and told it to summarize it in a way that is culturally sensitive to people of Jewish, Christian, Muslim, Hindu, and Buddhist religious faiths. It's still chugging.
